cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for cross-border digital payments.
cells.note: Uganda's Minister for EAC Affairs told Parliament on 3 November 2026 that the East African Payment System links the RTGS systems of Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania and Rwanda (TZA-007), a regional payment system in service, so stage 4; the TIPS-RSwitch link is still a pilot and does not set it. No figure for cross-border payments is held, so not 5.
